headline: Production Operator
summary: TESDA-certified production operator with a year on an electronics assembly line. I run pick-and-place and reflow machines, assemble small components under magnification, watch the line and conveyors for problems and inspect boards before they move on. I follow ESD and safety rules closely.

experience.title: Production Operator
bullets: Operate pick-and-place and reflow machines on a surface-mount line making sensor boards.
Assemble connectors and small parts by hand under a microscope.
Watch the line and conveyor for jams or misfeeds and alert the technician right away.
Inspect boards visually and log defects before they move to testing.

experience.title: Production Trainee
bullets: Learned line procedures, 5S and ESD rules and assisted operators on the packing line.

education.credential: Electronic Products Assembly and Servicing NC II
Senior High School, TVL Track – Electronics
